// H4-024 exit routes on current52. Expected literal: O01–O32 frozen ba9b9f7.
// Reuses accredited ordinary-contract routes; assertions never call product calculation helpers.

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {readFile,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {resolve} from 'node:path';
import {createHash,randomUUID as uid} from 'node:crypto';

let h:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof isolatedReality>>;
before(async()=>{h=await isolatedReality('crm_h4024_exit',58601);});
after(async()=>{await h?.close();});
const seed=async()=>{const f=await confirmationFixture(h);await f.apply(await f.register());return f;};
const reject=async(f:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof confirmationFixture>>,q:Parameters<typeof f.apply>[0])=>{await assert.rejects(f.apply(q));};
const facts=(q:any,change:any)=>({...q.facts,...change});
test('H4-02452 H4-010 R05 actual Requirement received is not satisfied; S2 proceeds; explicit review later',async()=>{const f=await seed(),r=await requirementFixture(h,f.b);const basis={...r.basis,scope:{serviceId:f.service.id,action:'confirm'}};await h.requirements.apply(await h.auth(),write,await r.need({basis}));await f.apply(await f.evaluate());assert.equal((await f.assess())!.usable,false);await h.requirements.apply(await h.auth(),write,await r.receive(await r.document({coverage:[basis.scope]})));await f.apply(await f.evaluate());assert.equal((await f.assess())!.usable,false);assert.equal((await r.see())!.status,'Recibido');const s2=await confirmationFixture(h,f.b,1);await s2.apply(await s2.register());await s2.apply(await s2.evaluate());assert.equal((await s2.assess())!.usable,true);await h.requirements.apply(await h.auth(),write,await r.review());await f.apply(await f.evaluate());assert.equal((await f.assess())!.usable,true);assert.equal((await r.see())!.status,'Revisado');});
test('H4-02452 H4-010 R04 fact12 cannot cover16 other time units provider scope price conditions',async()=>{const f=await seed();for(const c of [{quantity:'16'},{unitRevisionId:(await h.cat('unit',{name:'SYNTHETIC vehicles',definition:'vehicle capacity'})).revision},{time:'16:00:00+02:00'},{conditions:'SYNTHETIC uncovered different conditions'},{commercialBasis:{terms:'uncovered price'}}])await reject(f,await f.evaluate({coverage:{...f.coverage,...c}}));const g=await confirmationFixture(h);await reject(f,await f.evaluate({coverage:g.coverage}));assert.equal((await f.assess())!.usable,false);});
test('H4-02452 H4-010 R08 AC020 hay sitio12 not own confirmed fact or firm reserve16',async()=>{const f=await confirmationFixture(h),a=await availabilityFixture(h,f.b);await a.apply(await a.receive());await a.apply(await a.verify());assert.equal((await a.assess())!.serviceConfirmed,false);await reject(f,await f.register({certainty:'communicated',content:'SYNTHETIC hay sitio12',recordId:((await a.state())!.response!.recordId)}));await f.apply(await f.register());assert.equal((await f.assess())!.usable,false);await f.apply(await f.evaluate());assert.equal((await f.assess())!.usable,true);assert.equal((await a.assess({...a.coverage,quantity:'16'}))!.usable,false);});
test('H4-02452 H4-012-F16 C01/C02 B actual request after A fixed H2 conversion and A to B applied',async()=>{const f=await counterpartyFixture(h),m=await f.fresh(),apply=await f.prepare(m,{provider:f.B.revision});const approved:any=await f.current();assert.equal(approved.booking.detail.services[0].provider,f.A.revision);await m.run(apply);const current:any=await f.current();assert.equal(current.booking.detail.services[0].provider,f.B.revision);assert.equal(current.booking.accepted_detail.services[0].provider,f.A.revision);const next=await f.fresh();await next.run(await f.request(next,f.B,{date:'2026-10-22'},2));assert.equal((await next.see())!.progress,'Solicitada');});
test('H4-02452 H4-012-F16 C06 applied V2 accepts only pertinent variant Offering and retains V1',async()=>{const f=await counterpartyFixture(h,{fixed:true,variant:true}),m=await f.fresh();await m.run(await f.prepare(m,{variant:f.V2.revision}));const current:any=await f.current();assert.equal(current.booking.detail.services[0].variant,f.V2.revision);assert.equal(current.booking.accepted_detail.services[0].variant,f.V1.revision);const next=await f.fresh();await next.run(await f.request(next,f.A,{date:'2026-10-22'},2));await f.pending(next);await next.run(await f.response(next,f.SV2));});
test('H4-02452 H4-012-F16 C08 old A and desired B evidence remain distinct before application',async()=>{const f=await counterpartyFixture(h),m=await f.fresh();await m.run(await m.request([{id:m.partId,scope:f.scope,expectedScopeRevision:1,desired:{provider:f.B.revision},aspects:['provider'],dependencies:[]}]));await f.pending(m);await assert.rejects(m.run(await f.response(m,f.SA)),/MODIFICATION_SOURCE_REQUIRED/);await assert.rejects(m.run(await f.response(m,f.SB,{sourceBasis:'before'})),/MODIFICATION_SOURCE_REQUIRED/);const before=(await m.see())!.parts[0]!.before;await assert.rejects(m.run(await f.response(m,f.SA,{sourceBasis:'before'})),/MODIFICATION_RESPONSE_SCOPE_REQUIRED/);await m.run(await f.response(m,f.SA,{sourceBasis:'before',coverage:{[m.partId]:before}}));const proofA=(await m.see() as any).response;assert.equal(proofA.source.id,f.A.revision);assert.equal((await f.current() as any).booking.detail.services[0].provider,f.A.revision);await m.run(await m.command('provider',{partIds:[m.partId],commitment:'SYNTHETIC new B commitment independent of former A release',recordId:null}));await m.run(await f.response(m,f.SB,{happenedAt:'2026-10-04T10:00:00Z'}));const state:any=await m.see();assert.equal(state.response.source.id,f.B.revision);assert.ok(state.history.some((x:any)=>JSON.stringify(x).includes(f.A.revision)));assert.equal((await f.current() as any).booking.detail.services[0].provider,f.A.revision);});
test('H4-02452 H4-014 C16 distinct actual H2 modality prices never mixed; per-participation rights sum after materialization',async()=>{const a=await cancellationFixture(h,{count:3,amount:'100.01',otherAmount:'120.00'}),b=await cancellationFixture(h,{existing:{f:a.f,b:a.b,detail:a.detail},index:1,count:3,amount:'120.00'});const x=await a.run(await a.command()),y=await b.run(await b.command());assert.equal(x.result.computed.right,'150.03');assert.equal(y.result.computed.right,'180.00');assert.equal(x.result.computed.baseTotal,'300.03');assert.equal(y.result.computed.baseTotal,'360.00');assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b04_participants where booking_id=${a.b.bookingId}::uuid`)[0]!.n,0);assert.notEqual(x.result.facts.base.modalityId,y.result.facts.base.modalityId);assert.equal(x.result.facts.base.amount,'100.01');assert.equal(y.result.facts.base.amount,'120.00');});
test('H4-02452 H4-014 C07 PM07 explicit legitimate fixed900 remains900 without dividing by participants',async()=>{const f=await cancellationFixture(h,{amount:'900.00',count:12,scopeKind:'service'}),q=await f.command();const r=await f.run(await f.command({facts:facts(q,{cause:'provider',base:await f.base('900.00','fixed')})}));assert.equal(r.result.computed.baseTotal,'900.00');assert.equal(r.result.computed.right,'900.00');assert.equal(r.result.computed.retention,'0.00');assert.equal(r.result.facts.base.count,1);});
test('H4-02452 H4-016 R18 PM06 real Refund 50.01 minus20 minus30.01',async()=>{const f=await refundFixture(h,'100.01','100.01','voluntary');await f.run(await f.determine());assert.equal((await f.view()).right,'50.01');await(await f.approval(await f.authorization('50.01'))).execute();await f.run(await f.movement('20.00'));assert.equal((await f.view()).pendingRight,'30.01');await f.run(await f.movement('30.01','20.00'));assert.equal((await f.view()).pendingRight,'0.00');assert.equal((await f.view()).executed,'50.01');assert.equal((await f.view()).status,'Ejecutada');});

test('H4-02452 H4-018 D07-11 AC036 canonical guarantee Refund external custody 100 /20 /30 /50',async()=>{const paymentsBefore=(await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b05_customer_payments`)[0]!.n;const f=await depositFixture(h);await f.initialize();await f.run(await f.delivery());await f.run(await f.evaluate());const q=await f.determination();await(await f.approval(q)).execute();let p=await f.view();assert.equal(p.amounts.returned,'0.00');assert.equal(p.amounts.pendingReturn,'80.00');await f.run(await f.fact('retain','20.00','0.00'));p=await f.view();assert.equal(p.amounts.retained,'20.00');assert.equal(p.amounts.pendingReturn,'80.00');const r=await f.fact('return','30.00','20.00');await h.refunds.applyGuarantee(await h.auth(),write,r);p=await f.view();assert.equal(p.amounts.returned,'30.00');assert.equal(p.amounts.pendingReturn,'50.00');await f.run(await f.fact('return','50.00','50.00'));p=await f.view();assert.equal(p.amounts.returned,'80.00');assert.equal(p.amounts.pendingReturn,'0.00');assert.equal(p.amounts.resolved,true);const rf=await h.refunds.read(await h.auth(),read,f.bid,p.refundId);assert.equal(rf.baseType,'guarantee');assert.equal(rf.executed,'80.00');assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b05_customer_payments`)[0]!.n,paymentsBefore);assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b05_refund_movements where refund_id=${p.refundId}::uuid`)[0]!.n,2);});
test('H4-02452 H4-018 D04/05 delivery40 then60 and reliable fact replay',async()=>{const f=await depositFixture(h);await f.initialize();const q=await f.delivery('40.00');await f.run(q);assert.equal((await f.view()).amounts.remainingDelivery,'60.00');assert.equal((await f.view()).amounts.resolved,false);await assert.rejects(f.run(await f.evaluate()));await f.run(await f.delivery('60.00','40.00'));assert.equal((await f.view()).amounts.remainingDelivery,'0.00');const before=await f.view();assert.equal((await f.run(await f.attest({...q,operationId:uid(),expectedRevision:before.revision}))).replayed,true);assert.deepEqual(await f.view(),before);});
const setup=async()=>{const f=await refundFixture(h);await f.run(await f.determine());await(await f.approval(await f.authorization())).execute();const inc=await f.incident(),attempt={id:uid(),sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC same attempted transfer outcome uncertain',portion:await f.portion('80.00')};await f.run(await f.command('uncertain',{attempt,incidentId:inc.incidentId}));return{f,inc,attempt};};
const partial=async(f:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof refundFixture>>,attempt:{id:string},amount='20.00',start='0.00')=>{const move=await f.movement(amount,start);return f.command('resolve',{attemptId:attempt.id,resolution:'occurred',movement:move.movement});};
test('H4-02452 F23 C01/C02 original ordinary route denied, linked partial progress must succeed',async()=>{const{f,attempt}=await setup(),ordinary=await f.movement('20.00'),q=await f.command('resolve',{attemptId:attempt.id,resolution:'occurred',movement:ordinary.movement}),before=await f.view(),fundsBefore=await f.a.see();let ordinaryError='',error='';await assert.rejects(f.run(ordinary),e=>{ordinaryError=String(e);return /PORTIONS_REQUIRED/.test(ordinaryError);});try{await f.run(q);}catch(e){error=String(e);}const after=await f.view(),fundsAfter=await f.a.see();if(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR)await writeFile(resolve(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR,'F23-original-state.json'),JSON.stringify({ordinary,q,before,fundsBefore,ordinaryError,error,after,fundsAfter},null,2)+'\n');assert.equal(error,'');assert.equal(after.executed,'20.00');assert.equal(after.pendingRight,'180.00');assert.equal(after.pendingAuthorized,'180.00');assert.equal(after.uncertain,'60.00');assert.equal(fundsAfter.summary.refundReserved,'60.00');assert.equal(after.attempts[0].resolved,false);assert.deepEqual(after.attempts[0].portion,before.attempts[0].portion);});
test('H4-02452 F23 C02 ordinary record cannot bypass uncertain reserve by supplying attemptId',async()=>{const{f,attempt}=await setup(),q=await f.movement('20.00','0.00',{attemptId:attempt.id}),before=await f.view();let error='';try{await f.run(q);}catch(e){error=String(e);}const after=await f.view();if(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR)await writeFile(resolve(process.env.H4014_CAPTURE_DIR,'F24-original-state.json'),JSON.stringify({q,before,error,after,funds:await f.a.see()},null,2)+'\n');assert.notEqual(error,'');assert.deepEqual(after,before);});
for(const result of ['not_occurred','occurred']as const)test('H4-02452 F23 C03/C04 partial20 then rest60 '+result,async()=>{const{f,attempt}=await setup(),original=await f.view();await f.run(await partial(f,attempt));const q=result==='occurred'?await partial(f,attempt,'60.00','20.00'):await f.command('resolve',{attemptId:attempt.id,resolution:result});await f.run(q);const v=await f.view();assert.equal(v.executed,result==='occurred'?'80.00':'20.00');assert.equal(v.pendingRight,result==='occurred'?'120.00':'180.00');assert.equal(v.pendingAuthorized,v.pendingRight);assert.equal(v.uncertain,'0.00');assert.equal(v.attempts[0].resolved,true);assert.deepEqual(v.attempts[0].portion,original.attempts[0].portion);assert.equal(v.movements.length,result==='occurred'?2:1);assert.equal(v.movements[0].material.sourceAttemptId,attempt.id);assert.equal(v.attempts[0].progress.length,2);assert.equal((await f.a.see()).summary.refundReserved,'0.00');});
test('H4-02452 F23 C06 Incident resolved never releases remaining60 or permits dangerous retry',async()=>{const{f,attempt,inc}=await setup();await f.run(await partial(f,attempt));await h.incidents.apply(await h.auth(),write,await inc.resolve());await assert.rejects(f.run(await f.movement('60.00','20.00')));await assert.rejects(h.allocations.apply(await h.auth(),write,await f.a.assign('80.00')));assert.equal((await f.view()).uncertain,'60.00');assert.equal((await f.view()).executed,'20.00');});
